title: Character twists and localized coherent closed pushforward
statement: Let $F$ be a field and $T/F$ a group scheme, with character group $X=\operatorname{Hom}(T,\mathbf G_m)$ and ring $R=\mathbf Z[X]$ as in [def-sfb-trivial-torus-coherent-data]. Let $T$ act on an $F$-scheme $Y$, and use its action groupoid, coherent linearized modules, integral quotient $G_0^T(Y)$, linearization $\beta_M:a^*M\simeq p^*M$, and equivariant pushforward predicate from [def-sfb-equivariant-coherent-gzero]. A character twist $N=M(\chi)$ is an underlying-sheaf isomorphism $e:N\simeq M$ satisfying $p^*e\,;\beta_M^{-1}\,;\chi=\beta_N^{-1}\,;a^*e$, where the scalar is pulled back from $T$ on $T\times_FY$. A character action on the existing additive quotient is an actual $R$-module structure, together with existence of every twist representative and $e^\chi[M]=[N]$ for every such representative. Put $\Sigma=\langle 1-e^\chi:\chi\ne0\rangle\subset R$, the multiplicative closure, including $1$. For an equivariant morphism $i:W\to Y$ and character actions on both integral groups, the localized closed-pushforward isomorphism property means that there exists an $R$-linear map $p:G_0^T(W)\to G_0^T(Y)$, that every coherent equivariant $N$ on $W$ has an ordinary equivariant pushforward representative $M$, that $p[N]=[M]$ for every such representative, and that $\operatorname{id}_{R_\Sigma}\otimes p:R_\Sigma\otimes_R G_0^T(W)\to R_\Sigma\otimes_R G_0^T(Y)$ is bijective. This is the canonical commuted tensor order of $G_0^T(-)\otimes_RR_\Sigma$. For a closed immersion it describes ordinary closed pushforward, with its map fixed on all generators, not a chosen arbitrary map.
